details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

**Heavy Frame — Passive:** Stability 2; an explicit creature trait, not a bonus from size.

**Healing:** Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

**Senses:** Ordinary sight and hearing.

**Signs:** Frozen carcasses hang in sheltered clefts above the hunting ground.

**Purpose:** Preserve a hunting territory and the memories buried in its ice.

**Tactics and retreat:** Freeze a narrow approach, then pull a separated target away from the group.

**Counterplay and conversation:** Avoid the narrow ice lane and bargain over what lies preserved beneath it.

**Habitat:** Glacier; frozen coast · **Communication:** Common and Draconic

**Loot:** A single hoard: propose 300 coins and one recovered historical object with a story.

**Summoning:** Ineligible.
details.designNotesMarkdown:
## Design notes — not needed during play

**ID:** creature-rime-dragon


**Category:** Dragon · **Role:** Winter ambusher · **CV:** 59

### Creature-roll reference

| Attack | Attribute | Attack modifier | Weak attack | Standard attack | Strong attack |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Hooking talons | Brawn | 2 Boons | 5 physical damage. | 7 physical damage. Pull 1. | 9 physical damage. Pull 2. |
| Winter breath | Brawn | 2 Boons | 5 cold damage. | 7 cold damage. Freezing 1. | 9 cold damage. Freezing 2. |
| Ice-edged bite | Brawn | 2 Boons | 4 cold damage. | 6 cold damage; Freezing 1. | 9 cold damage; Freezing 2. |

The incoming attack names the defense attribute; use the six values above. Same targeting, costs and limits apply in either perspective. No opposed second roll.


### CV worksheet

**Difficulty rationale:** No innate attack modifier; armor, cover and chosen actions provide its defenses. Its dangerous attack imposes defense Banes.

**Reference damage:** 5/7/9

**Reference type:** physical

**Expected targets:** 1

**Utility factor:** 1.8

**Action review (#1279):** U 1.65 → 1.8: Maneuver allowance +0, Reaction allowance +0.15. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=3.000, O=7.012. CV uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/bestiary/encounters.md); action choices, Stability and control are not simulated. Recalibration remains required.

**Ability sources:** [breath](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/breath.md), [drag under](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/drag-under.md), [rime dragon ice anchor](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/rime-dragon-ice-anchor.md), [Splintering Rime](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/splintering-rime.md), [wing beat](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/wing-beat.md).
